artists.biography:
Neutral Milk Hotel was an American indie rock band formed in Ruston, Louisiana by singer, guitarist, and songwriter Jeff Mangum in the late 1980s. The band is noted for its experimental sound, abstract lyrics and eclectic instrumentation.

The first release under the Neutral Milk Hotel moniker was the 1994 EP Everything Is, a short collection of tracks featuring Mangum. On the band's full-length debut album On Avery Island, which followed shortly thereafter, Mangum was joined by childhood friend and Apples in Stereo frontman Robert Schneider, who contributed production and instrumentation. Upon the album's release, the full band was formed and extensive touring began.

Neutral Milk Hotel released In the Aeroplane Over the Sea in 1998, which became their best-known and most critically acclaimed album. Although the album did not meet commercial success at the time of release, it has gone on to sell over 300,000 copies and received critical acclaim from several publications, including Pitchfork Media, Magnet Magazine, AllMusic, and The Pazz & Jop poll. Despite growing popularity, the group disbanded in 1999 after Mangum became disenchanted with touring and the music press, later having a nervous breakdown.

Neutral Milk Hotel is a part of the Elephant 6 Recording Company. The band was one of Elephant 6's three first projects, alongside The Apples in Stereo and The Olivia Tremor Control.

On April 29, 2013, the band announced a reunion tour for the fall of 2013 with the lineup that played on In the Aeroplane Over the Sea via their record label's website.

perplexity.description:
The Collected Works of Neutral Milk Hotel, released in 2023 by Merge Records, is a comprehensive vinyl box set that compiles the complete recorded output of the influential indie rock project led by Jeff Mangum. The collection centers on Neutral Milk Hotel’s two seminal studio albums—On Avery Island (1996) and In the Aeroplane Over the Sea (1998)—both presented in expanded, deluxe editions. The set also includes the rare 1994 EP Everything Is, the Ferris Wheel on Fire 10-inch, and a series of 7-inch singles, offering a thorough overview of the band’s brief but impactful career. Musically, the box set showcases Neutral Milk Hotel’s signature blend of lo-fi production, surreal lyrics, and eclectic instrumentation, drawing from folk, psychedelic rock, and experimental traditions.

This release marks the first official digital debut of several tracks previously only available on a limited 2011 self-released compilation, as well as the inclusion of previously unreleased recordings such as studio demos and live performances, including the long-mythologized “Little Birds.” The box set is notable for its archival depth, featuring new artwork, remastered tracks, and detailed documentation of the band’s creative timeline. While not a new studio album, The Collected Works solidifies Neutral Milk Hotel’s legacy as a cornerstone of 1990s indie rock, celebrated for its emotional intensity and innovative songwriting. The collection has been well-received by critics and fans alike for its historical significance and the care taken in its curation.
